tasks.title: Briefs keep whole gotchas
tasks.summary: A brief cuts a finished blocker's gotchas at 400 characters, mid-sentence, and silently drops the rest. Keep whole entries and say what was left out.
acceptance: A test: gotchas under the limit appear whole, with every line indented
A test: gotchas over the limit keep whole bullets only and end with a line naming how many more and the evidence path
A test: one entry over the limit is cut at a sentence end, with the same pointer
make audit still passes the worker budget

tasks.title: The handoff uses decision numbers
tasks.summary: The handoff quotes gotchas with P numbers while the evidence and briefs say D numbers.
acceptance: A test: a task whose gotchas mention P1 lands, and session_handoff.md says the D number and not P1
An existing batch-numbering test still passes unchanged

tasks.title: Docs a task names are in scope
tasks.summary: Settle warns about a changed file the task lists under docs.
acceptance: A test: a changed path listed in docs gives no warning, in both settle_gates and ready_gates
A test: a changed path in neither list still warns
A test: a task with empty files and some docs still gets no check
ws protocol task-schema says docs paths may be changed

tasks.title: Plan citations resolve, and validate warns early
tasks.summary: A finding that is a table row in the plan reads as missing, and nobody hears until a worker's brief says so.
acceptance: A test: find_section resolves G7 to a table row starting with G7, and not to one starting with G70
A test: a heading still wins over a table row
A test: ws validate warns once for a workstream, listing refs that open tasks cite and PLAN.md doesn't have
A test: ws seed --from-plan prints the same warning
A test: a done task's citation, and a workstream with no written PLAN.md, give no warning

tasks.title: Validate warns about a verify prefix that stops short
tasks.summary: `VAR=x a && b` sets VAR for a only, so b can fail on a bare `ws verify`.
acceptance: A test: an open task verifying with `A=1 cargo test && make lint` warns, naming A
A test: a [commands] key whose command has that shape warns too
A test: `A=1 cargo test`, `export A=1 && b` and a done task give no warning

tasks.title: Blocking a task keeps its notes
tasks.summary: Settling a blocked task overwrites the planner's notes with the reason.
acceptance: A test: a blocked task keeps its notes, and blockedReason holds the reason
A test: the handoff's Blocked list shows the reason
A test: landing, ws unclaim and ws reset each clear blockedReason
A test: an older queue without the field still loads and validates against the schema

tasks.title: Briefs and task definitions read from the integration checkout
tasks.summary: From a worktree, a brief misses decisions and notes made after the claim, and ws verify can run an old verify list.
acceptance: A test: after a claim, a decision and a note made on the integration branch appear in ws brief run from the worktree
A test: ws update --verify on the integration branch is what ws verify runs from the worktree
A test: ws verify, ws commit and evidence still act on the worktree
A test: with no checkout on the integration branch, the brief reads the current checkout

tasks.title: The wave shows blocked tasks and holds back shared files
tasks.summary: ws wave offered MBZ-08 while MBZ-06, on the same files, was unfinished, and doesn't list blocked tasks at all.
acceptance: A test: a candidate sharing a file with a blocked or in-progress task isn't offered, and heldBack names it, the other task and the path
A test: when every candidate is held back the wave is stuck, exit 3
A test: an unrelated later-phase task is still offered, and the existing fall-through test passes unchanged
A test: ws wave prints blocked tasks with their reason, and held tasks with their cause
A test: ws claim --commit refuses the same overlap
A test: ws validate warns on an overlap across phases
ws snapshot output passes its schema with heldBack, and the lanes screen shows it

tasks.title: ws decide --commit
tasks.summary: ws decide leaves the commit to you, and an uncommitted decision blocks settle's checkout check and a branch's view of it.
acceptance: A test: ws decide --commit makes one commit holding only DECISIONS.md and prints the hash
A test: it works on a lite workstream with no DECISIONS.md yet
A test: on another branch, or with dirty tracking files, it refuses and writes nothing
A test: without the flag it behaves as before

tasks.title: Decisions can be closed
tasks.summary: An open decision stays open forever: the log only grows, and nothing says a later entry settled it.
acceptance: A test: ws decide --closes D015 adds an entry with a Closes line and leaves D015's text unchanged
A test: ws decisions --open lists D014 and not D015 afterwards
A test: an unknown id, or one already closed, is refused and writes nothing
ws-coordinate names both, and the protocol test parses them

tasks.title: Acceptance can be corrected, citing a decision
tasks.summary: When a decision changes what a task must prove, its acceptance can't follow, so a brief prints the old target beside a note correcting it.
acceptance: A test: ws update T --acceptance 3 text --because D018 replaces item 3 and appends the decision
A test: a manual item stays manual
A test: a missing --because, an unknown decision, an item that doesn't exist, and a done task are each refused
A test: --commit commits the queue
A test: the brief and evidence skeleton from a worktree show the new text
ws-coordinate names it, and the protocol test parses it

tasks.title: Open decisions surface in briefs, settle and the stop rules
tasks.summary: MBZ-05 landed with D015 open. Its next task's acceptance still assumed the old result, and a worker spent 97k tokens finding that out.
acceptance: A test: a brief shows an open decision from a direct or transitive blocker right after Acceptance, and not a closed one
A test: ws settle prints each open decision it numbers and the tasks waiting
A test: the handoff lists open decisions
A test: ws claim still succeeds with one open
ws protocol stop has the new rule, and make audit passes

tasks.title: Resuming a blocked task
tasks.summary: A blocked task can land later, but nothing says how, and a second worker spent 60k tokens re-checking finished work.
acceptance: A test: a blocked task's brief opens with Resuming: its reason, commit count, evidence path and the decisions its branch lacks
A test: its finish steps don't say ws evidence new
A test: a todo or in-progress task's brief is unchanged
ws-run documents resuming and says not to unclaim
make audit passes

tasks.title: Acceptance items can name expected output
tasks.summary: The gates trust the evidence's shape: an item quoting 72/5/16 under an acceptance of 75/2/16 passes every one.
acceptance: A test: an expect string missing from the log fails ws verify, ws evidence check and ws settle
A test: a string that is present passes, with ANSI codes in the log
A test: an item with no expect behaves as before
A test: manual with expect is refused
A test: a --key subset doesn't fail until every key has run on one tree
The schema accepts the field, and the protocol and ws-plan name it

tasks.title: Prove it end to end
tasks.summary: Replay the MBZ-06 story on a sample repo with the real CLI, run the real evals, refresh the generated agent files and write down what's true.
acceptance: Each step in the plan's end-to-end section is run on a sample repo, with the output quoted
evals gain a resume scenario, and tests/test_evals.py covers it with the stub agent
ws adapt claude-code --check says OK after refreshing
make eval AGENT=claude-code passes on Opus 5.5 at medium effort, with its cost recorded
docs/decisions/0012-run-feedback.md lists each issue, its fix, and what stays unproven
tasks.notes: The user approved Claude Code eval spend for this task, about $2 last time. Don't run Copilot evals: they use paid work-account credits.

inScope: the ws CLI, its protocol and skills
the issues found on the MBZ-06 run
this repo's eval scenarios and decision record
outOfScope: rewriting past decisions or finished tasks
scope.rule: Fix only your task's issue: anything else you notice goes under Gotchas.
